record.question: How do the selected trailheads connect to lakes, passes and each other?
record.reason: Eight published western approaches from Crabtree, Gianelli, Bell Meadow, plus six northern approaches, now have sourced bounded graphs. Northern coverage includes Kennedy Lake, Relief Reservoir, Waterhouse Lake, Cooper Meadow, Eagle Pass and the southbound Sonora PCT to the Leavitt Lake trail junction. Kennedy display geometry remains unreviewed; southern entries, deeper lake/pass branches, cross-boundary itineraries, returns and individual facility spurs remain incomplete. No destination-wide route completeness is claimed.
